There is no evidence of supply-chain tampering or malicious activity.

The package adheres to standard AUR packaging practices. The checksum is provided and matches the source, and the build process is transparent and reproducible. No post-install hooks or system modifications are included in the PKGBUILD. The maintainer metadata is present but unremarkable. Overall, the file shows no signs of malicious intent or risky behavior.
